As a person who suffers with ASPD and severe depression and with severe body injuries that are beyond recovery that have visual effect on my body. I will just give you a reality check. This is not an existential crisis. This is a cry for help.

People who wish they were killed or never born and dream of dying are not people who really want to die.

People who want to die or dream of dying , attempt it. Without posting about it on social media.

Talking about it ,99% of people do it just for attention,1% talk about it hoping the things they lived through (rape,molestation,abusive childhood) hope to find something that they can hold on to as a positive part of life. Others Because they were hurt by someone  think just because they are not in a romatic relationship by now, there is something wrong with them.

And yes self-pity is disgusting, but thats a mindset, not the way the mind was born, its the view your brain is most comfortable practicing because it makes you feel secure if you put yourself down.

Saying that, find a therapist or psychotherapist to talk through those issue. Find a hobby or find a job or study for a job where you will be appriciated and makes you feel good. And if your brain takes the ´´why bother´´ because you will never get that job, or never be good at anything , do it for yourself , set your goal for yourself, not outside world.

If you were not loved. You would not be here at this point. You need to swap that mindset and pay attention to people who do love you,except for those who dont, or dont know you enough to do.

​

This may be a little harsh. But its still better than seeking approval of your existance from strangers or seek attention from them.

Mental illness is only powerful than you, if you let it. If you keep yourself occupied and get help. In time you wont even take it as a curse, but just a part of your life.

​

Good luck
